description: This file defines a RealtimeService class in Dart for Flutter applications, providing WebSocket and SSE connectivity with JWT authorization, reconnection with exponential backoff, and message handling. It facilitates real-time communication, topic subscription management, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: Helper class for exponential backoff with jitter used during reconnection attempts.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main class providing real-time communication via WebSocket and SSE with features like subscription management, automatic reconnection, and JWT authorization.

methods.name: withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate RealtimeService with an external token getter function.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to the server, attempting WebSocket first and falling back to SSE if needed.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific topic, subscribing via WebSocket or reconnecting with SSE to include the new topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specified topic, updating subscriptions via WebSocket or reconnecting with SSE.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes active connections and stops reconnection attempts.
